f218c9cd1e96ec38.description: Asia's leading robotics solutions provider, automating enterprise supply chains since 2017. We build syncOS — the industry-first no-code platform that lets manufacturers and warehouse operators integrate, reprogram, and scale automation systems without halting production or calling in specialists. Our autonomous mobile robots (AMRs) run 24/7 for global brands — transforming production lines in hours, not weeks. Our product stack spans AMR hardware and robot software through fleet management and SyncOS — the software layer that orchestrates automation workflows, coordinates fleets and equipment, connects them with enterprise systems, and makes automated operations observable and manageable. As robotic systems scale from individual deployments to complex operations, increasingly difficult product problems move into the software layer: which robot should execute which task, how fleets share constrained infrastructure, how workflows adapt as operating conditions change, and how problems are detected and understood before operations are disrupted. We are building the product team responsible for this layer. As a Senior Product Manager on SyncOS, you will own a significant part of the platform and take hard systems problems from operational need to product model to system behaviour to measurable production outcome. **KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:** - Autonomous Fleet Intelligence & Orchestration - Build the intelligence that determines how autonomous fleets operate under real-world constraints. This spans the decisions that determine which robot does what, how shared resources are allocated, how competing priorities are resolved, and how the system adapts as operating conditions change — reducing dependence on operator intervention and site-specific logic - Operational Intelligence & Observability - Turn operational data and deployment learning into intelligence that helps customers understand and improve their automated operations. Build the product capabilities needed to make system health and performance observable, detect developing problems before they disrupt operations, and put failures in context when they occur - Own a meaningful SyncOS problem space and its roadmap, outcomes and product decisions - Start from operational problems rather than feature requests, and define precisely how the system should behave - Use production and deployment evidence to identify where the product needs to become more intelligent, configurable or reusable - Distinguish customer-specific needs from capabilities that should become part of the product - Define measurable product outcomes, system behaviour and acceptance conditions before engineering work begins - Partner deeply with software, robotics, solutions and deployment teams from problem definition through production validation **Requirements** - 5–7 years of product-management experience building technically complex software products. Particularly interested in people who have worked on workflow, orchestration, scheduling, logistics, data-intensive products or developer/platform tools - Worked naturally from operational data: defining events, states and metrics and using production evidence to make product decisions - Shipped systems where software makes operational decisions or helps users understand and act on complex system behaviour - Turned repeated customer-specific work into configurable or reusable product capability - Worked deeply enough with backend/platform engineers to reason about state, contention, dependencies, race conditions and failure modes - Written product specifications precise enough to define rules, edge cases and expected behaviour when multiple constraints conflict **Highly Desireable:** - Experience with multi-agent/fleet coordination, logistics optimisation, workflow/low-code platforms, observability and operational tooling, or WMS/MES/ERP and industrial integrations - Experience in robotics, AMR/AGV, intralogistics, warehouse automation or industrial systems is valuable but not required **Benefits** - Competitive salary - Comprehensive health benefits package - Hustle of a young startup, always something to do and something to improve - Opportunities for professional development and growth into management roles - Collaborative and inclusive work environment

Position Description

Title: Senior Financial Analyst

Location: Bangalore

Shift: US Shift timing

Role Description

The Business Unit Finance group of CGI’s Corporate Finance division is responsible for assisting the business sectors in its profitable growth and operations by providing value-added decision support and financial analysis.

We have a challenging and rewarding career opportunity for a Senior Financial Analyst to support the Toronto Financial Services (TFS) business unit. Reporting directly into the Finance group, you will be primarily responsible for partnering with operational leadership and finance colleagues to deliver accurate, timely and highly valued accounting and financial support.

Key Responsibilities

The primary functions of this role consist of:

• Analytical support of the budgeting and forecast process, delivering well supported and documented financial plans
• Working closely with BU partners to understand their business, help them understand their financial drivers, and challenge their assumptions
• Delivering accurate, insightful and timely analysis of financial results compared against forecasts and budgets
• Managing project and client financials according to contract; understanding key terms in contracts, financial implications of changes in those terms and the technical accounting impact of contracts
• Preparing and presenting financial results with meaningful/accurate commentary to business unit stakeholders
• Analysis of Balance sheet entries ensuring balance sheet integrity
• Manage audit requests, collaborate on special projects and help drive efficiencies through continuous improvement

Key Skills & Competencies

• Proven analytical skills and ability to communicate to non-finance stakeholders
• A strong work ethic with high level of accountability for delivering quality work
• Proactive attitude towards verifying financial information and initiative to bring issues to resolution
• High level of comfort in challenging business assumptions by leveraging logic and critical thinking
• Highly organized and business process oriented

Qualifications & Education

• Bachelor’s degree in accounting or finance, CPA designation or working towards one is preferable
• 3-4 years of experience in a similar business partner financial analyst role

Experience

• Excellent computer skills with MS Office software including Excel, Word, and PowerPoint
• Previous experience working with industry software such as PeopleSoft, Hyperion (Oracle) would be considered valuable assets

Your future duties and responsibilities

Required Qualifications To Be Successful In This Role

Your work creates value. You’ll develop innovative solutions and build relationships with teammates and clients while accessing global capabilities to scale your ideas, embrace new opportunities, and benefit from expansive industry and technology expertise.

You’ll shape your career by joining a company built to grow and last. You’ll be supported by leaders who care about your health and well-being and provide you with opportunities to deepen your skills and broaden your horizons.

f2a7ef5e0d6cfcb1.description:
Spotter AI is on the lookout for a dedicated and detail-oriented Claims Specialist to enhance our claims processing team. This remote position is vital in ensuring that our clients receive prompt and fair assessments of their trucking claims. As a Trucking Claims Specialist, you will leverage your knowledge of trucking operations, maintenance costs, and claims management to deliver exceptional service.
Key Responsibilities:

• 
Claims Assessment: Review and evaluate trucking claims submitted by clients to determine their validity, coverage, and potential payouts. Conduct thorough investigations to collect relevant information from various parties involved, including drivers, trucking companies, and insurance adjusters.

• 
Cost Analysis: Utilize your expertise to analyze maintenance records, repair invoices, and other documentation to accurately calculate truck and trailer maintenance costs. This analysis is crucial for determining the appropriate claim amount and ensuring the claims process is efficient.

• 
Documentation and Reporting: Maintain accurate and comprehensive records of all claims, communications, and decisions made throughout the claims process. Prepare detailed reports as necessary to summarize findings and support claims decisions.

• 
Customer Communication: Serve as the primary point of contact for clients during the claims process. Communicate clearly and effectively, addressing any questions or concerns they may have while providing updates on claim status.

• 
Regulatory Compliance: Stay informed about industry regulations, company policies, and best practices related to claims processing. Ensure that all claims are handled in compliance with applicable laws and regulations to mitigate risk for both clients and the company.

• 
Continuous Improvement: Collaborate with team members to identify opportunities for improving claims processing efficiency and accuracy. Share insights and best practices to enhance overall team performance.

Qualifications:

• 
Industry Knowledge: Strong understanding of trucking operations, including familiarity with truck and trailer maintenance practices and costs. Previous experience in the trucking industry is a significant advantage.

• 
Claims Experience: Experience in claims processing, insurance, or a related field is preferred. Understanding of claims management software is a plus.

• 
Analytical Skills: Excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities. You should be capable of interpreting complex data and drawing accurate conclusions to support claims assessments.

• 
Communication Skills: Strong verbal and written communication skills are essential. You must be able to articulate findings clearly and work effectively with clients and colleagues.

• 
Attention to Detail: Detail-oriented with strong organizational skills. Ability to manage multiple claims simultaneously while ensuring accuracy and timeliness.

• 
Technical Proficiency: Proficiency in relevant software and tools for claims management and documentation. Comfortable using digital communication tools for remote work.

Why Join Spotter?

• 
Flexible Work Environment: Benefit from a fully remote work setup, allowing you to maintain a healthy work-life balance.

• 
Growth Opportunities: Be part of a forward-thinking company in the trucking industry, with opportunities for professional development and career advancement.

• 
Collaborative Culture: Join a supportive team that values collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement.

Headquarters: United States - Remote

About the role:

Forter is seeking an accomplished Regional Director, Enterprise Sales to lead our enterprise sales strategy and execution across the Eastern United States. This role will own regional revenue growth, new-logo acquisition, strategic account development, pipeline health, and forecast accuracy across a complex enterprise territory.

You will lead, coach, and develop a high-performing enterprise sales team while building executive relationships with major digital commerce, payments, and technology organizations. Using a consultative, value-based approach, you will help customers understand how Forter’s Trust Platform can reduce fraud and abuse, improve approval rates, optimize payments, and strengthen the customer experience.

This is a highly visible leadership role requiring strong commercial judgment, operational rigor, executive presence, and the ability to collaborate across Sales, Solutions Consulting, Customer Success, Marketing, Revenue Operations, Product, Analytics, Finance, and Partnerships. This position emphasizes regional revenue ownership, territory planning, pipeline creation, forecasting discipline, strategic negotiations, and cross-functional execution. 

What you'll be doing:

• Own the Eastern US enterprise sales strategy, regional revenue plan, and execution against bookings and new-logo objectives.

• Lead regional territory planning, account segmentation, strategic account penetration, and coordinated go-to-market planning.

• Build and maintain a healthy, predictable enterprise pipeline through account-based prospecting, executive engagement, partner development, and collaboration with Sales Development and Marketing.

• Coach and develop Enterprise Account Executives on discovery, qualification, value-based selling, deal strategy, negotiation, account planning, and executive communication.

• Establish consistent operating rigor across pipeline inspection, opportunity management, forecasting, CRM hygiene, and performance reviews.

• Drive accurate weekly, monthly, and quarterly forecasts using data, deal inspection, and clear risk assessment.

• Engage senior executives and economic buyers across eCommerce, payments, fraud, risk, finance, operations, and technology functions.

• Lead complex, multi-stakeholder enterprise sales cycles from opportunity creation through presentation, negotiation, contracting, and close.

• Promote a structured sales methodology (MEDDPICC) to improve qualification, deal velocity, forecast accuracy, and execution consistency. Comparable market roles increasingly reference structured methodologies and tool-based pipeline governance.

• Collaborate with Solutions Consulting to develop tailored demonstrations, business cases, value narratives, and ROI models.

• Partner with Customer Success and Implementation to align customer expectations, support expansion opportunities, and ensure a strong transition from sales to delivery.

• Work with Marketing, Revenue Operations, Product, Analytics, Finance, and Partnerships to improve messaging, territory strategy, competitive positioning, and regional execution.

• Provide customer and market insight to internal stakeholders to influence product priorities, sales enablement, and go-to-market planning.

• Serve as an executive sponsor for strategic opportunities and customer relationships.

• Represent Forter at relevant industry events, customer meetings, and executive forums.

• Build a culture of accountability, inclusion, continuous improvement, and customer focus across the regional sales organization.

What you'll need:

• 10+ years of experience in enterprise technology, SaaS, fintech, payments, cybersecurity, fraud prevention, eCommerce, or a closely related market.

• 3-5 years of experience leading enterprise sales teams, including demonstrated success hiring, coaching, developing, and retaining top sales talent.

• Proven track record of exceeding revenue and quota objectives in complex enterprise sales environments.

• Experience managing an Eastern US territory and selling to large, multi-region or Fortune 1000 organizations.

• Demonstrated success leading complex sales cycles with multiple business, technical, financial, and executive stakeholders.

• Strong understanding of consultative, value-based, and account-based enterprise selling.

• Experience with pipeline management, territory planning, forecasting, inspection, and sales performance analytics.

• Ability to engage credibly with C-level executives and translate complex technology into clear business value.

• Excellent executive presence, negotiation skills, presentation skills, and written and verbal communication.

Who We Are
Hi, we're DuckDuckGo, the online protection company and remote-first team of 300+ on a mission to raise the standard of trust online. Founded in 2008 and profitable since 2014, annual revenue now exceeds $100m USD and millions use our browser on on Mac, Windows, iOS, and Android, our search engine, and the DuckDuckGo subscription. We also offer private, useful, and optional AI, including Duck.ai, which lets you chat privately with ChatGPT, Claude, and other AIs, all in one place. Our culture of trust, inclusivity, and empowered project management underpins everything we do, where each team member takes full ownership of their projects, from scoping and execution to postmortem. If you're seeking end-to-end ownership of your work, you've come to the right place!

Your Team and Role
Working on the Data Science Functional Team, you'll drive product and business impact through improving our search engine ranking and results. Recent projects include:
• 
Improving first-phase ranking quality and precision without sacrificing latency
• 
Developing new lexical-matching and document-authority signals
• 
Expanding our search evaluations to measure relevancy readiness and surface ranking blindspots 
• 
Investigating LLMs for feature generation and ranking
 
Our data meets rigorous privacy standards and is necessarily sparse, so you'll need to think creatively to surface actionable insights in an evidence-first culture where quantitative rigor is the baseline, not the exception.

About You
• 
You have 10+ years of experience in Data Science, with 2+ years at Staff, Principal, or Director level, and a track record of leading high-complexity projects from scoping to production with minimal direction.
• 
You are comfortable advising others on complex data science work.
• 
You can develop strategies for ambiguous, complex data science problems and turn them into a series of well-defined projects.
• 
You have hands-on experience deploying ML in production, developing NLP solutions, and in AI-assisted development.
• 
You write production-grade code in Python or a comparable high-level language.
• 
You have advanced SQL and query optimization skills.
• 
You collaborate effectively with product teams and contribute to overall team throughput.
• 
Preferred experience:
• 
Running search-specific projects (ranking, retrieval, or indexing) from scoping to production
• 
Working with large-scale search infrastructure (e.g. Vespa, Elasticsearch, OpenSearch, or Solr)

Compensation
$222,033 USD annually and stock options. Compensation is transparent across the organization, and all team members within the same professional level and global region receive the same compensation.
Eligibility for company-sponsored health benefits is limited to team members based in the United States. This program does not extend to team members located in other countries, such as Canada or the UK.
Our Team Member Support Guide explains how we prioritize your wellbeing including paid parental leave, office setup, and co-working allowances.

Hiring Process
Hiring works best when it's a two-way street. Learn how we help you get to know DuckDuckGo, envision your future role here, and find out more about how we hire.

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion
DuckDuckGo provides equal work opportunities to all team members and applicants, and it prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type on the basis of race, color, ethnicity, caste, religion, age, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by our policies or federal, state, or local laws.

We want to ensure that our hiring process is accessible. If you need reasonable accommodation for any part of the application process because of a medical condition or disability, please send an email to

You’ll be required to attend meetings on camera via video conferencing
• 
Expect to travel at least two times a year: once for our all-hands meetup and again for a team retreat (each around 4-5 days). While extenuating circumstances may impact attendance, everyone is strongly encouraged to attend.
• 
While we offer a flexible work arrangement with no core hours, expect an average full-time commitment of 40 hours per week.
• 
A successful candidate must pass a background check as a condition of joining the team.
• 
By applying for this role, you confirm that all information submitted is accurate and complete. You further acknowledge that providing false or fraudulent information during the application process is cause for denial of an offer, revocation of any existing offer, or other adverse action, up to and including termination after the start of your commencement of work.

We use AI to flag potentially fraudulent applications, analyze and summarize applicants’ experience, interviews, and project performance, and help streamline our selection process.
